serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.ArmBoth.DownNormal
#bot.Expression.Angry
#Annalie.face.sad
Bot: Annalie! 
Bot: This is terrible…{{wi}} I wish I was here to eliminate people responsible!
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: Did you get my messages?
Annalie: I did…
Bot: Why didn’t you answer?
Annalie: As you can see, I was pretty busy with the repairs.
Bot: We could’ve helped you, you know?
Annalie: Sorry, but I have my pride.
Annalie: I have been running this shop on my own for a quite some time now and I’m not too keen on asking people for help.
#bot.Expression.verysad
Bot: Why?
Annalie: I don’t wanna talk about this, especially now.
#bot.Expression.sad
You: Now that we are here, how about we help you? You look tired. Did you get any sleep at all?
Annalie: To be honest, not really.
#Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Annalie: Don’t worry about me! New windows are on their way already so there are only finishing touches to be done.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: We insist on helping!
#bot.Expression.veryHappy
#Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Annalie: Alright. I don’t think I have any choice anyway.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Don’t worry Annalie, I’m 36% more efficient than a human male. It will be done in a second.
Annalie: Did you hear that Mr. boyfriend? Your girlfriend just dissed you. You better work hard if you want to keep up.
You: I don’t think that’s possible…
